Senses.PreferredTarget: the original constitution is just so
Senses.Note: Two Tier-2 witnesses retain the phrase, while Nanyue Lanzan’s lamp verse is kept as the one distinct lamp recension. The parallel Suxi verse family was removed.

Occurrences.Kwic: 無事坐何曾有人喚。向外覓功夫總是癡頑漢。糧不畜一粒逢飯但知𭚜。世間多事人相趁渾不及。我不樂生天亦不愛福田。饑來喫飯困來即眠。愚人笑我智乃知焉。不是癡鈍本體如然。要去即去要住即住。身披一破衲脚著孃生袴。多言復多語由來反相誤。若欲度眾生無過且自度。莫謾求真佛真佛不可見。妙
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T51/T51n2076.xml). Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp. Nanyue Lanzan sets the phrase in Lanzan’s song beside “not stupidity, originally just so”.

Occurrences.Kwic: 滿肚。內除戒律精嚴，不學威儀行步。三乘笑我無能，我笑三乘謾做。智人權立階梯，大道本無迷悟。達者不假修治，不在能言能語。披麻目視雲霄，遮莫王侯不顧。道人本體如然，不是知佛去處。生也猶如著衫，死也還同脫袴。生死無喜無憂，八風豈能驚怖。外相猶似癡人，肚裏非常峭措。活計雖無一
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1298.xml). Gāthās and Verses of the Chan Gate’s Patriarchs: The heading names Suxi (蘇溪) as the author of the Herding-and-Guarding Song, whose verse says that the wayfarer’s original constitution is just so.

Occurrences.Kwic: 湖和尚一日點淨後不赴堂，遂入方丈裏睡。齋後，知事來白云：和尚何不赴堂？鵝湖云：莊上喫油糍來。晚閒，莊主到，云：今日謝和尚喫油糍。大眾！為復是師通妙用，本體如然，平地上剛然揑怪？既不與麼，又作麼生？良久，云：者箇公案一任天下人批判，保寧也無神通妙用，亦無宿命。他心院在江
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X69/X69n1350.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Baoning Renyong. Baoning Renyong asks whether Ehu’s claimed marvel is original constitution or a fabricated oddity.

Senses.Explanation: The phrase says that the underlying constitution is just so. Nanyue Lanzan’s retained verse sets it beside “not stupidity,” while Baoning Renyong asks whether a claimed marvel is original constitution or a fabricated oddity. The other retained witness preserves the phrase in a song against contrived cultivation.
